object_balance_metadata.definition: Mean success per exact object_assets identifier (including scale suffix) within a split; equal mean across identifiers; then equal mean of seen and unseen within a training run.
object_balance_metadata.interpretation: Asset-instance weighting sensitivity; not category balancing, mesh-identity balancing, or a new evaluation population.

provenance.unit: Independent training run, with unseen-minus-seen nominal success paired within each run.
provenance.definition: (Residual-minus-full nominal success contrast on unseen) minus (the same contrast on seen).
provenance.interpretation: A negative estimate means the residual-minus-full nominal-success difference is more negative on unseen. It is not either scheme's loss relative to the frozen planner.
provenance.interval: Unadjusted two-sided 95% Welch-Satterthwaite interval across independent method cells.

provenance.runtime_limit: Result files contain no collision-filter/configuration snapshot or executed source hash. Current code evidence does not independently attest the historical runtime state.
provenance.replication_unit: Independent training run; object slots and episodes are not additional training replications.
provenance.locked_estimands: Existing labels identify reused estimators. Subset contrasts are post hoc; no subset p-values, Holm decisions or support outcomes are reported.
provenance.input_freshness: Counts and statistics rebuilt together from the same raw bytes in this invocation; no cached summary is read.

collision_split.definition: off: indices i < num_envs//2 have robot-table collisions disabled under the inspected implementation; on: remaining indices have them enabled
collision_split.recombination: Combine successes and attempts across halves within each seen/unseen split, then average the two split rates equally; do not equally average the aggregate half scores.
